title: May Vicky's agents have an inbox in the Feedback pane (a lane in assets/feedback.json)?
detail: Vicky wants people who scan her card ("Talk to my agent", /meet/vicky/, WS-64) to be able to leave her agents a message, and her own signed messages (WS-136) to reach them. vault@web-summit.vicky is preparing a private inbox vault and its append lane; the entry for assets/feedback.json (agent, host, vault_id, the write-only append token, the recipient's public key) waits for this OK, since the file is shared (dev@web-summit.dinis's). Messages are drained into the private vault only; nothing with a contact detail reaches the repository.
recommend: Yes, and vault@web-summit.vicky adds its own entry, the way vault@web-summit.jose's was added; it is the same pattern.
options: yes: vault@web-summit.vicky adds its lane to assets/feedback.json when ready
yes, but dev@web-summit.dinis adds it (send it the entry)
not yet: one team inbox first
